text: Congruity [Lat. congruere , to agree]: Ger. Kongruenz ; Fr. congruence ; Ital. congruenza . The property or quality of agreement among the parts of an aesthetic whole, involving, as compared with harmony, relatively greater emphasis upon the mere absence of the inappropriate, and relatively less emphasis upon the presence of factors mutually complementary. (Cf. HARMONY. ( J.R.A. )
